# Chest of Books

> A comprehensive digital library offering free access to classic books, reference materials, and practical guides across dozens of subjects from literature and history to science, crafts, and practical skills.

Chest of Books is a curated collection of public domain and classic texts spanning literature, reference materials, natural sciences, practical guides, and specialized knowledge. The collection emphasizes both timeless literary works and practical instructional content for learners and researchers.

## Literature and Storytelling

- [Novels](https://chestofbooks.com/novel/index.html): Classic novels by Jane Austen, Charlotte Bronte and famous authors
- [Fairy Tales](https://chestofbooks.com/fairy-tale/index.html): Fairy tales, fables, myths and folk tales from around the world

## Reference and Knowledge

- [Reference Books](https://chestofbooks.com/reference/index.html): Encyclopedias, dictionaries and formulas providing general knowledge
- [History Books](https://chestofbooks.com/history/index.html): History, anthropology, biography and historical events reference books
- [Language Books](https://chestofbooks.com/languages/index.html): Linguistics, shorthand and grammar lessons including Gregg shorthand

## Natural Sciences and Animals

- [Animal Books](https://chestofbooks.com/animals/index.html): Stories and reference books on dogs, cats, horses, pets, birds, fish
- [Flora, Herb, Mushroom and Plant Books](https://chestofbooks.com/flora-plants/index.html): Wildflowers, herbs, mushrooms and botanical guides for plant identification

## Practical Guides and Skills

- [Gardening and Horticulture Books](https://chestofbooks.com/gardening-horticulture/index.html): Gardening, horticulture and plant care guides for growing food
- [Cook Books](https://chestofbooks.com/food/index.html): Vintage cookbooks with recipes, vegetarian cooking and dietary guides
- [Craft and Hobby Books](https://chestofbooks.com/crafts/index.html): Craft, hobby and DIY guides covering mechanics, metalwork and machinery
- [Home Improvements Books](https://chestofbooks.com/home-improvement/index.html): DIY guides for home improvement, woodworking, furniture and construction

## Professional and Technical References

- [Computer Books](https://chestofbooks.com/computers/index.html): Programming languages, version control and software development guides
- [Architecture and Construction Books](https://chestofbooks.com/architecture/index.html): Architecture, buildings and construction reference books and guides
- [Business Books](https://chestofbooks.com/business/index.html): Business reference, law, entrepreneurship and parliamentary procedure guides
- [Finance Books](https://chestofbooks.com/finance/index.html): Economics, banking, investments and personal finance reference books
- [Real Estate Books](https://chestofbooks.com/real-estate/index.html): Real estate guides covering buying, selling and property management

## Arts, Health, and Spirituality

- [Art and Photography Books](https://chestofbooks.com/arts/index.html): Art and photography books covering techniques and portrait photography
- [Health and Healing Books](https://chestofbooks.com/health/index.html): Alternative medicine, herbal remedies, homeopathy and nutrition references
- [Religion Books](https://chestofbooks.com/religion/index.html): Religion, theosophy, spirituality and philosophy reference books
- [New Age Books](https://chestofbooks.com/new-age/index.html): Dream interpretation, astrology, paranormal abilities and spirituality
